provenance.note: Provenance: every rationale below was settled in the 2026-04-27 review of the three bootstrap corpora, which re-curated the pools by adding ``_AUDIT_REMOVE_PER_SOURCE`` to short-circuit keywords with no plausible PII adjacency, modifying ``_KEYWORD_OVERRIDES`` per the Pool A/B exception lists, and re-scoping or re-weighting ``_MANUAL_MEDICAL`` and ``_MANUAL_GENERIC`` entries. The 47-entry ``_MANUAL_AUDIT_PART3`` fills the originally-empty cells with primary-source-backed candidates. Later financial-document and label-phrase additions carry their own dated ``source_id``.

keyword_overrides.rationale: Court case-number format per 28 U.S.C. § 1914 and FRCP Rule 10; canonical 9-digit-shape confusable for SSN/NPI/DEA on federal court dockets.
Court docket number; canonical confusable for SSN/NPI/DEA on captions .
Standalone 'docket' token is weaker than 'docket number'; SSN-shape only per US Courts glossary.
Defendant captions are name-adjacent; FRCP 5.2 requires SSN already redacted in caption blocks.
Plaintiff captions are name-adjacent; FRCP 5.2 requires SSN already redacted in caption blocks.
UBL cbc:ID invoice identifier; canonical sequential-9-digit confusable for SSN.
UBL cac:PayeeFinancialAccount/cbc:ID; checking account numbers commonly 9-12 digits, high SSN-shape confusable.
ABA RTN is exactly 9 digits with check digit per Federal Reserve E-Payments Routing Directory; very high shape confusable .
UBL cac:OrderReference/cbc:ID; high SSN-shape confusable. NPI fanout dropped — UBL does not carry healthcare provider IDs.

TIN field per IRS Form W-9 Part I and NUCC CMS-1500 Box 25; SSN/EIN alternative shares 9-digit shape. De-weighted 0.55 -> 0.35 (2026-06-11): a TIN field is the designated label for a sole proprietor's SSN, so at 0.55 the suppression dropped label-boosted SSNs below the balanced cutoff; 0.35 is the ambiguous-term weight (boosted SSNs surface, bare 9-digit shapes still drop at balanced).
5 U.S.C. § 552(b)(6) personal-privacy exemption; marking exists because PII has been redacted.
DOJ FOIA Reference Guide §IX redaction marker; on real FOIA responses sits next to redacted PII (Pool B narrowing).
DOJ FOIA Reference Guide §IV; document-context indicator with weak direct PII adjacency.

entries.rationale: Drug lot numbers per 21 CFR 201.18 are alphanumeric pharmaceutical batch IDs. NPI fanout dropped — lot codes do not 10-digit-shape match NPIs.
10/11-digit NDC near 'NDC' is overwhelmingly NDC not NPI per FDA NDC Directory.
UB-04 visit identifier; HIPAA Safe Harbor 45 CFR 164.514(b)(2)(i)(J) account-numbers category.
Room numbers 3-4 digits; weak DOB-shape confusable (e.g. 'room 1234' looks like a DOB stem). Rescoped from (ssn,npi).
Lab specimen identifier; institutional non-PII per NUCC Box 23 CLIA context.
Medical Record Number per HIPAA Safe Harbor 45 CFR 164.514(b)(2)(i)(H); per-institution 6-10 digit identifier with high SSN-shape confusable rate.
Variant of MRN per HIPAA Safe Harbor 45 CFR 164.514(b)(2)(i)(H).
NUCC CMS-1500 Box 26 Patient's Account No.; institutional account ID. Distinct from the (ssn, financial) override on the same keyword .
Bed identifiers are short numeric tokens; weak DOB-shape confusable on census sheets. Rescoped from (ssn,).
Ward/unit IDs on hospital routing slips.
NUCC CMS-1500 Box 11b Other Claim ID; CMS ICN/DCN at UB-04 FL 37.
Encounter identifier per HIPAA Safe Harbor (J) account-numbers category.
UB-04 admission identifier per CMS Medicare Claims Processing Manual Pub. 100-04 Ch. 25.
Lab/imaging order number; institutional identifier. NPI fanout dropped.
Pharmacy fill ID near DEA-shaped string is overwhelmingly the pharmacy fill ID per 21 CFR 1306.05; not DEA registration. Rescoped from (ssn,npi).
NCPDP pharmacy ID confusable with DEA when shape overlaps; per DEA Pharmacist's Manual. Rescoped from (npi,).
Generic physician ID label may legitimately co-occur with DEA registration number; low suppression weight to preserve recall. Rescoped from (npi,).
Generic provider ID label may co-occur with DEA; low weight preserves recall. Rescoped from (npi,).
Lab specimen accession identifier per NUCC Box 23 CLIA context.
Numeric label barcodes on specimens; (npi) scope rejected as barcode contents pattern-defined by GS1/HIBC, not directly NPI confusable. Lowered from 0.45.
21 CFR 1304.04 inventory identifier is institution-internal, not DEA registration #. Rescoped from (ssn,).
Drug batch ID; near 10-digit string usually batch not NPI per 21 CFR Part 207. SSN fanout dropped.
CPT/HCPCS 5-digit not DEA-shaped; weak relevance. (ssn,npi) scope rejected as catastrophic FN risk.
NUCC CMS-1500 Box 24A Date(s) of Service; date-shaped string near service-date label is overwhelmingly DOS not DOB. Scope strictly medical to avoid catastrophic FN on non-medical documents .
NUCC CMS-1500 Box 18 admission date; HIPAA Safe Harbor (C) treats admission date as PHI but the label suppresses DOB-confusion only on medical doctype.
NUCC CMS-1500 Box 18 discharge date; same scoping as admission date.
Variable-length sequential identifier per UBL BuyerReference; common 9-digit shape. NPI fanout dropped.
USPS IMpb 22-digit domestic / 13-char alphanumeric international per USPS Publication 199.
E-commerce sequential ID per UBL OrderReference.
Booking/order confirmation; variable-length sequential identifier .
Variable-length point-of-sale identifier.
Variable-length transaction identifier; Regulation E electronic fund transfer context.
Travel/reservation identifier; variable-length sequential.
Vendor-assigned customer identifier; variable-length. NPI fanout dropped.
UBL BuyerReference / account-reference variant; sequential identifier.
Sequential quote identifier.
Support-system identifier; variable-length sequential.
Customer-support case identifier.
API/system request identifier; variable-length.
Product serial number per HIPAA Safe Harbor (M) device serials category. NPI fanout dropped.
Product model identifier; weaker shape match per HIPAA Safe Harbor (M) device serials.
Booking variant; variable-length sequential.
c/o Clerk of Court address is a court office address, not a party-identifier address.
Federal courthouse addresses are public locations, not party PII.
Bank branch address on receipts and statements; not customer PII.
Merchant street address on receipts and 1099 PAYER address blocks; not customer PII.
USPS Domestic Mail Manual sender block; letterhead From: addresses are typically business not natural-person PII.
Return address per USPS DMM is the sender block; commonly business address.
NUCC CMS-1500 Box 33 billing-provider address; provider not patient address.
Insurance company address in claim header; not patient PII.
NUCC CMS-1500 Box 32 service-facility address; not patient PII.
DEA Diversion Control Division FOIA Library publishes redacted MOAs and audit reports; suppression context.
DEA Form 224 registration application released through DEA FOIA carries DEA registration #; the form name signals suppression context.
NCPDP pharmacy ID is 7-digit, format-distinct from DEA 9-char alphanumeric. Suppresses DEA-shape false positives near pharmacy provider blocks.
Formulary IDs and codes adjacent to medication lists are non-DEA institutional codes.
21 CFR 1304.04 inventory line items are non-DEA codes; DEA registration # appears in the document header, not on the inventory line.
UBL cbc:DueDate is invoice payment due date, not DOB.
Bank statement period dates per Regulation E; not DOB.
Transaction date label per 1099 instructions; date-shaped string overwhelmingly transaction not DOB.
Generic document issue date; date-shaped string near issue date label is overwhelmingly issue not DOB.
NUCC CMS-1500 Box 14 last-menstrual-period date qualifier.
Legal-entity name suffixes per FRCP Rule 17 indicate corporate party not natural-person PII.
Attorney signature blocks per FRCP and 28 U.S.C. § 1654; attorney names appear publicly in case captions.
State Bar Number following attorney name in caption block; non-PII identifier.
Case caption v. (versus) separates public party names.
Bank branch name in transaction blocks; not customer PII.
Merchant name on receipts; not customer PII.
Bank legal-name suffix per Federal Reserve MDRM (e.g., Wells Fargo Bank, N.A.); institution not customer name .
USPS Domestic Mail Manual From: block typically business not natural-person.
Document-type label, not patient name.
Department name in hospital letterhead; not patient name.
Hospital name in letterhead; institution not patient PII.
Medical center name; institution not patient PII.
DOJ OIG audit reports cite provider NPIs in published findings; partial confusable context.
HHS OCR breach notices reference covered entity; 10-digit string in this context is typically entity-NPI cross-reference, but suppression weight reflects potential real NPI presence .
CPT codes are 5-digit per NUCC Box 24D; weak 10-digit confusable but appears alongside NPI on CMS-1500.
HCPCS codes per NUCC Box 24D; same 5-digit shape as CPT.
Legacy Unique Physician Identification Number per NUCC Box 17a qualifier 1G; appears on archival pre-2007 documents .
5 U.S.C. § 552(b)(6) personal-privacy exemption marker indicates redaction has already occurred; suppression context .
5 U.S.C. § 552(b)(7)(C) law-enforcement personal-privacy exemption.
Exemption 7 threshold language per DOJ FOIA Guide chapter on Exemption 7.
Exemption 6 and 7(C) statutory phrase per DOJ FOIA Guide.
DOJ FOIA Reference Guide §IX redaction notation.
DOJ FOIA Reference Guide §IX redaction notation.
CMS Document Control Number; synonym for ICN at UB-04 FL 37.
NUCC CMS-1500 Box 11; 9-character alphanumeric per 5 U.S.C. § 8101 federal-employee work-injury claims.
CMS Internal Control Number; 13-digit Medicare claim ID at UB-04 FL 37.

Medicare Beneficiary Identifier card label; 11-char alphanumeric replacing the SSN-based HICN since 2020-01-01 under MACRA 2015 SSNRI. The bare token 'mbi' was retired: the engine matches by substring and it fired inside 'combined', 'ambiguous' and 'columbia'.
Colloquial label for the Medicare Beneficiary Identifier; weaker than the card label.
NUCC CMS-1500 Box 11 Insured's Policy, Group, or FECA Number.
NUCC CMS-1500 Box 1a; payer-assigned member ID, high SSN-shape confusable.
NUCC v13 Item 1a/Item 6 reference; payer-assigned identifier.
NUCC CMS-1500 Box 9a, Box 11.
Industry variant of NUCC CMS-1500 Box 1a Insured's I.D. Number.
Ex-dividend-date labels appear in brokerage statements; very specific to equity distributions.
Settlement-date labels appear in brokerage and banking activity records.
Maturity-date labels appear in fixed-income and CD account statements.
Expiration-date labels appear on credit-card statements and benefits notices.
Effective-date labels mark when account terms or policies begin.
Issue-date labels on financial docs mark document or instrument generation date; weight is lighter because 'issue date' is also found near personal records.
Tax-year labels on 1040/W-2/1099 forms are designed to mark the filing year, not birth year.
Fiscal-year labels on financial statements mark the accounting period.
Check-number labels in bank statements hold sequential payment identifiers.
Loan-number labels in mortgage and credit statements hold account identifiers, not SSNs.
Member-number labels in credit-union and insurance statements hold membership IDs.
Claim-number labels in insurance statements hold case-tracking IDs, not SSNs.
Control-number labels on W-2 (box d) hold the employer-assigned payroll ID, not the recipient SSN.
Confirmation-number labels in transaction records hold transaction-tracking codes.
Employer's EIN label (W-2 box b) is adjacent to the SSN box (box a); the 9-digit EIN in that position is not an SSN.
Transit-number labels in banking hold ABA routing codes; 9-digit but not SSNs.
Amount-due labels on billing statements mark payment totals; adjacent numbers are account identifiers, not SSNs.
Balance-due labels on billing statements mark outstanding totals; adjacent numbers are account identifiers, not SSNs.
Issuer labels on bond/securities statements hold the issuing entity's name, not a personal name.
Fund-name labels on investment statements hold mutual fund or ETF names.
Institution-name labels on financial forms identify the holding bank or brokerage.
Plan-name labels on 401k/403b statements hold the retirement plan sponsor name.

IRS label phrases for the employer identification number on W-2, W-9 and 1099 forms; the 9-digit EIN shares the SSN shape. The bare token 'ein' was retired: the engine matches by substring and it fired inside 'herein', 'foreign' and 'reinvest'.
